company: Global Air Logistics and Training, Inc. (GALT Aerospace)
dod_intent_evidence: Overwhelming — News: '$950,000,000 ceiling indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract' for ABMS (2020) and 'GALT Awarded $23.9M Prime Contract to Provide Communication Enhancements for the USMC' (2021), plus two Air Force Phase II SBIRs in the SBIR section.
score_evidence: 'proven execution from concept to fielded capability' and 'from early development through production and sustainment' → they are past the valley, in production/sustainment

About page lists ABMS MAC, EWAAC, SeaPort-NxG plus CMG, ATI (MATAC, IWRP, NSTIC, NAC) and SOSSEC consortia → the acquisition-pathway problem Barry solves is already solved here, and it also marks them as a services/integration house

Open roles include 'Assistant Facility Security Officer', 'Contracts Administrator', 'Cybersecurity Specialist', 'Senior Logistics Engineer', 'Instructional Systems Designer' → deployment, compliance, sustainment and training functions are already staffed, the opposite of the hiring skew we score for

Their own product language is already deployment-fluent: 'Purpose-built for low SWaP and low cost, it delivers robust, survivable connectivity' and 'successful at the contested edge of the battlespace'
what_they_do: SDVOSB defense systems house building airborne networking gateways, tactical data links and weapon data links (DAGNE, FINN, SkyTower II, SR-WAVE) plus joint data network operator training.
